correctness.rationale: For edges uv of K_n, signed Roman closed-neighborhood sum is T-S_u-S_v+2f_uv. In the asymmetric (a,b) cut a=n/2-1,b=n/2+1 with cross -1 and internal 2 on H_A,H_B, the incident sums are -3+d_A(u),1+d_B(v), yielding the four exact degree inequalities plus cross-edge defender t>=1+Delta_A+Delta_B. At weight four, H_B matching s=floor(b/2), H_A five-cycle for n=12 or path with r=n/2+2-s edges for n>=14 meet inequalities. The lower T=1,2,3 cases in this cut class contradict the degree constraints and internal B nonedges. The bipartition is uniquely recovered by negative labels, so counting injective; n=12 and n=14 counts 997920,113513400 confirmed. Independent direct original-neighborhood checks for n=12,14,16,20 passed. This is NOT proof gamma_sR=4 among all labelings.
residual_risks: Global gamma_sR remains between 2 and 4, with no claim equality 4; the counted subfamily is not exhaustive.
